summary.zh: 多项目组合的计划、进度与风险跟踪
summary.en: Plan multi-workstream programs and track status, risks and capacity.

description.zh: 面向跨团队的多项目组合，产出计划、状态报告、风险台账和人力容量视图，并支持向管理层汇报。适合同时盯多个工作流、需要定期向上同步进度时使用。
description.en: Runs planning, status reports, risk registers and capacity views for multi-workstream programs, plus executive updates. Useful when several workstreams run at once and leadership needs a clear read.
